vectors.description: A complete, minimal, self-consistent valid payload -- the same payload as payload-hash/001-minimal-payload.json.
A valid payload with zero attachments (SPEC.md section 6.3) -- structured claims only, no files.
schema_version is required and must be checked before anything else in the payload.
A schema_version this producer's consumer does not support.
attachments[].content_hash must be a 64-character lowercase SHA-256 hex digest.
attachments[].mime_type is limited to types the consumer can actually preview/embed/export.
Every attachments[].id must be unique within a payload.
Every observations[].id must be unique within a payload.
observations[].attachment_ref, if present, must match an attachments[].id in the same payload.
capture_timestamp must be a real ISO 8601 calendar date/time, not just a string matching the pattern.
source_url, if present, must be an absolute http(s) URL.
metadata must not contain __proto__, constructor, or prototype keys at any depth.
The envelope is a closed shape -- no additional top-level properties are accepted.
observations[].confidence, if present, must be in the closed interval [0, 1].
